item.title: MOH: Median Wait For Ward Bed From Emergency Department 144 Minutes
item.description:
Source: CodeBlue (Malaysia Health)
Health Minister Dzulkefly Ahmad says patients admitted from emergency departments in government hospitals wait a median 144.4 minutes for a ward bed. Rising disease burden, specialist shortages, and patients shifting from private care are straining public hospitals. The post MOH: Median Wait For Ward Bed From Emergency Department 144 Minutes appeared first on CodeBlue .
